principle: Ten-part sheet kit closes a seven-voussoir radial compression arch between tenoned abutments on a tied base
distinctions: Not a new decoration on the earlier tilted-mortise easel: seven freely contacting wedge blocks, finite heel bearing, no display panel or re-indexable angled slots

Not a reskin of Span & Slot: prior arch-shaped trestles were single solid panels carrying a deck; this kit builds the arch itself from radial contacts, with a pressure-line and friction-demand calculation
Not a rocking/pendulum/gear fidget; no repeated motion mechanism is claimed
Carrier and import/persistence infrastructure are reused deliberately; all new assembly parts, proportions, joints, packing and compression checks are original
